description:
This frame is well known as a traditional Dutch delivery bicycle. Combining strength and looks, the WorkCycles Double Tube Transport is a modern vehicle built for maximum utility. A timeless, Dutch delivery bike hand-made with the best materials and components. The WorkCycles Transport is a modern vehicle built for maximum utility... not just another wimpy, retro-style copycat. Double-top-tube frame of large diameter steel tubing, lots of stainless steel parts and hardware, tough powdercoat, ultra reinforced wheels, and typical WorkCycles attention to detail. The frame-fixed front carrier doesn't turn with the handlebars meaning that this workbike steers nicely even when heavily loaded. Smooth rolling, remarkably solid and tough the Transport Double-Tube will provide many years of convenient, reliable, and stylish service.

The bike comes with a vintage style chain case, a vinyl covered spring saddle and square bend transport handlebars. The bike is ideal for around town riding, errands, grocery shopping, a leisurely cruise, essentially a good solid bike for relaxed city rides. Like all WorkCycles bicycles the Transport with double top tube can be built to suit your needs and tastes: you can choose amongst a broad range of options for gearing, brakes, front and rear carriers, saddles, tires and more. The Transport with double top tube comes powder coated in matte black or gloss black with a vintage touch; a gold pinstripe line on the chain case & fenders.
